observations: The live Studio server reported 36 tools, matching the direct host inventory.
Exactly seven tools are marked dashboard-callable: get_console_output, get_studio_state, inspect_instance, list_roblox_studios, screen_capture, script_read, and search_game_tree.
The remaining 29 tools are blocked. This includes four tools the Studio server itself labels read-only but which have no named Lab route: http_get, script_grep, script_search, and skill.
Every reported tool supplied an input schema; no schema was missing or oversized.
The Lab was reconnected over the official Studio MCP protocol after the allowlist correction and listed both local Studio instances.
limitations: This is a read-only inventory and labeling result; no mutation, playtest input, sync, save, upload, or publish was performed.
The source snapshot is dirty because the allowlist correction is not yet committed; this record cannot support a VERIFIED capability.
The comparison covers the current Studio build and the current 36-tool inventory only; a Studio upgrade can change the list.
